result.summary: Found 1 issue: a content overlap causing text to be unreadable in the restaurant details.

issues.description: In the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' listing, the subtitle text appears to overlap or collide, showing garbled content ('25–3Order delivery' overlapping with delivery time), making the delivery time and category info unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Fix the text layout so delivery time, delivery cost, and category (Ramen) render as separate, non-overlapping elements with proper spacing.
